questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 140. If their LCM is 240 and HCF is 20, then find the smaller number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the numbers be 20x and 20y (where x and y are co-prime).

Sum: 20(x + y) = 140 ⇒ x + y = 7

LCM: 20xy = 240 ⇒ xy = 12

Numbers with sum 7 and product 12 are 3 and 4.

Smaller number = 20 × 3 = 60.

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of numbers (A + B) = 140, **LCM** = 240, **HCF** = 20.

**Formula Used:** Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf8f24327b08bcbb35949d6829efa949eb5d71926fe27677fe88607a22054c5d.png] 

⇒ A × B = 20 × 240 = 4800

⇒ We know (A − B)² = (A + B)² − 4AB

⇒ (A − B)² = (140)² − 4(4800)

⇒ (A − B)² = 19600 − 19200 = 400

⇒ A − B = √400 = 20

⇒ Adding (A + B = 140) and (A − B = 20): 2A = 160 ⇒ A = 80

⇒ Subtracting: 2B = 120 ⇒ B = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF and LCM Property

For any two numbers a and b, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).

Co-prime Relationship

If HCF of two numbers is h, then the numbers can be represented as hx and hy, where x and y are co-prime (HCF of x and y is 1).

LCM of Fractions

LCM of fractions = (LCM of numerators) ÷ (HCF of denominators).</p

questions.question: Which of the following processes converts liquid directly into its vapour form?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaporisation.**__

__
 
• **Vaporisation** converts liquid directly into its vapour form.

 
 
• Vaporization of an element or compound is a phase transition from the liquid phase to vapour.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

• This caused the water vapour to condense, or turn into its liquid form.
 
• Condensation is crucial to the water cycle because it is responsible for the formation of clouds.
 
 
 
• Vaporation: It is the process by which a liquid substance is converted into its gaseous phase or vapor. This transformation occurs when molecules within the liquid gain sufficient kinetic energy to overcome the intermolecular forces holding them together in the liquid phase. As a result, they escape from the liquid's surface and enter the surrounding space as vapor.
 
• Sublimation: It is the conversion of a solid directly into vapors.
 
 
• Sublimation takes place when the boiling point is less than the melting point.
 
• The heat required to change a unit mass of solid directly into vapors at a given temperature is called the heat of sublimation at that temperature.

questions.question: The Deccan Plateau is a triangular shaped plateau and is bounded by the _____ range in the North.
questions.solution:

• The Deccan Plateau is a triangular shaped plateau and is bounded by the Satpura range in the North.
 
• The Deccan Plateau is a triangular landmass that lies to the south of the river Narmada. ** **
 
• The plateau is bounded on the east and west by the Ghats, escarpments that meet at the plateau’s southern tip.
 
• Its northern extremity is the Satpura Range.
 
• Its principal rivers—the Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri (Cauvery)—flow from the Western Ghats eastward to the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Satpura range flanks its broad base in the north, while the Mahadev, the Kaimur hills and the Maikal range form its eastern extensions.
 
• An extension of the Plateau is also visible in the northeast, locally known as the Meghalaya, Karbi-Anglong Plateau and North Cachar Hills. 
 
• Dhupgarh (1,350 m) near Pachmarhi on Mahadev Hills is the highest peak of the Satpura Range.
